name: Kirishima
source:
Seemingly brawny and taciturn, Kirishima is also a resident of the mansion in Hanari. As one would expect from his appearance, Kirishima takes charge of any task that requires power. However, he also has a more delicate side in his alcohol-making hobby. Kirishima is able to travel between Hanamo and Hanari freely. 

A kind man, he regularly looks out for Saki. However, he also has tendencies to push people away. Ever since Saki arrived in Hanari, he begins to gradually recall his past that he had forgotten.

[Translation of the [URL=http://www.mead-soft.net/sakuragatari/character.php]official website's[/URL] character profile.]
